slug: 2025-10-03 ST Digital opens eco-responsible Tier III data centre in Cote d'Ivoire (Grand-Bassam)

facts.fact: ST Digital inaugurated its first Cote d'Ivoire data centre at VITIB II, Grand-Bassam, announced 2 October 2025.
TechAfrica News reports ST Digital's Grand-Bassam data centre as Tier III (operator-stated, no certifier named).
